description: FREE. Commit acceptance criteria BEFORE the work exists, for an independent work-acceptance record later. Send the criteria document ({criteria_set, version, title, criteria: [{id, title, requirement, required}]}) or only its sha256 so the content stays with you. Returns criteria_id and two RFC 3161 timestamp tokens (FreeTSA, DigiCert) plus a Bitcoin OpenTimestamps proof. The first commitment of a hash is permanent; committing again never moves its time. This is the 'criteria were fixed first' evidence dispute specs (ACP SEP #303 7.4a) require.

sha256.description: Or only sha256 hex of the criteria file

terms_ref.description: Optional sha256 of terms the counterparty signed (an AP2 mandate, a contract)

name: work_acceptance_criteria
